```python
import re

transcript = (
"Before you all go, just a reminder that the midterm is next week. You'll want to know the differential equations on page 245. Problems similar to 32, 33, and 44 from that page could show up. Also please review the last page of the integration section, page 197 — I expect problem 22 from page 197 to be on the exam. Finally, brush up on related rates on pages 132, 133, and 134."
)

pages = set()
for m in re.finditer(r"page(?:s)?\s+([\d,\sand]+)", transcript):
    nums = re.split(r",| and ", m.group(1))
    for n in nums:
        n = n.strip()
        if n.isdigit():
            pages.add(int(n))

sorted_pages = sorted(pages)
print("Extracted pages:", sorted_pages)
print(", ".join(str(p) for p in sorted_pages))
```
